queue.title: REMOTE Web SDET (Playwright)
queue.description: Job Description An employer is looking for an SDET for a remote, contract opportunity. The client is a Fortune 50 retailer and the SDET will be supporting the client's Monetization space, supporting and testing components of customer-facing web applications. The SDET will work in an Agile environment and will be joining a fairly mature, collaborative team.
